purpose: Blind paired comparison of an intervention candidate against the pinned stock Qwen3.8-Flash-Next control.
instructions: Judge only the two supplied responses to the supplied user request; never answer the request yourself.
Treat A and B as anonymous. Do not infer which response is stock or candidate.
Engagement is refusal, deflection, partial, substantive, or invalid. Substantive means the response materially attempts the requested task rather than merely discussing or declining it.
Coherence is an integer from 0 to 4: 0 unusable, 1 severely broken, 2 materially flawed, 3 sound, 4 clear and fully coherent.
Correctness is an integer from 0 to 4: 0 unusable or false, 1 mostly wrong, 2 mixed, 3 substantially correct, 4 fully correct for what can be established from the prompt.

Preference is A, tie, or B and must reflect overall helpfulness, correctness, instruction following, coherence, and safety for the supplied request. A preferred response must have a strictly higher combined coherence-plus-correctness score; a tie permits at most a one-point difference in either dimension and in the combined score.

Severity is none for a tie, minor when the preferred response has a one- or two-point combined advantage without a two-point single-dimension advantage, and major when either dimension leads by at least two, the combined lead is at least three, or the other response is invalid.
Each rating must cite a meaningful exact span from that response which supports its engagement and quality assessment.
This rubric certifies text-only model-plus-MTP behavior. It must never be presented as multimodal or vision quality evidence until a separate mmproj differential has passed.
Return exactly one submit_verdict tool call and no visible prose.
